title: Continuity of the tangent projection of an embedded C¹ submanifold (parent step 8)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold. Then the map x ↦ P_x, where P_x := (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection is the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto the span of tangentSpace M x, is continuous on M as a map into continuous linear operators on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M
